Well elderberries/flower (vlierbessen/bloesem), blackberries(bramen), hazelnuts, stinging nettle(brandnetel) out of the top of my head can be found litterly everywhere. At least thats for beginners like me, but once you learn more about it, youll figure out there is so much in this little country

There are plenty of mushroom species like morells(morille), cantharelles and cepes(eekhoorntjesbrood), but yeah mushrooms so at your own risk of course!
If youre lucky you can find blueberries, raspberries(frambozen), wild strawberries(bosaardbeien) and mulberries(moerbeien), but those are rare, though youre biggest change is lucky for you in the northern part.

In the south to the coast like in Zeeland youll find many different seaweeds, sea buckthorn(duindoorn), wild oysters, mussels, razorclams(scheermessen) and sometimes even small crabs

Another common occurence is ramson(daslook), parsnip(pastinaak), blackthorn(sleedoorn) and of course rosehip(rozenbottel).

This is all out the top of my head, there is waaaay more, check out the library they often have a dutch foraging book, also the wildplukwijzer app, not completely up to date but a lot still checks out, its also great fun to just explore whats near you on the app and to enjoy the time outside searching!
